Email [email protected]

Navigation

At our Moulded Glass facility in Lohr, Germany, we manufacture primary packaging made of type III glass for pharmaceutical, food and beverage applications.

Products include e.g. dropper bottles, syrup bottles and tablet containers for the pharma industry as well as glass bottles and jars for the food and beverage industry.
